note: Single LX relayouts timed on a Spyre card as their own programs: one profiler record per program (dbo-opt -dbo-autopilot-disable), median of 8 calls per record, two passes per move in one process, DeepTools 50663c1b, fp16, 2026-10-16. Log lx_relayout_sweep_20261016: torch-spyre main 55212fbc. Log lx_relayout_sweep_20261016b: torch-spyre main cf275104 with this change's own gate (no measurement-only change), split-16 permutations of 16-core tensors. 'permutation': a complete partition of the cores onto a complete partition of the same cores, timed between two pointwise ops in both directions. 'gather': a move into a matmul's replicated operand view. work_div hints set the two divisions; the first sweep process let the solver take moves past split 8 (a measurement-only change); the second used this change's gate. A record was kept only if exactly the expected relayouts fired at the expected governing (run, split), the values matched the CPU (permutations bit for bit, gathers within rtol 2e-2), and no backend compile ran while timing. feats holds the features relayout_ns reads; kernel_us is the measured time of the move's own program. Score with fit_relayout_law.py.
